# Reinforcement learning

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM
(`grpo.py`) and DeepSpeed/vLLM (`grpo_fast.py`) workflows remain current alternatives
for dense-model training; see [their guide](docs/algorithms/grpo.md).
Choose according to model and workload support, preserve the user's selected
workflow, and identify support gaps explicitly. MILES does not deprecate the
existing GRPO trainers.

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's
CUDA compatibility libraries, and an explicit value wins. Revalidate CUDA
initialization and a short training run when the image or driver changes. See
[Jupiter CUDA compatibility](docs/miles/launching.md#jupiter-cuda-compatibility).

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13 [--moe]] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MoE v2 (`OLMoDDPModel`) models, such as Olmo 3.5 Small, need `--cuda-version 13 --moe`: that image adds transformer-engine. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. Passing neither flag maps to an eight-hour protected, non-resumable job, the hardest kind to schedule. Prefer a realistic `--min_runtime` (the time the job needs to reach a checkpoint), and call out this choice before launching instead of silently copying a checked-in script's choice.
- On macOS, GRPO launch scripts that call `mason.py` need `--no_auto_dataset_cache` (before the `--` separator). Local dataset caching runs the training entrypoint with `--cache_dataset_only`, and `grpo.py` / `grpo_fast.py` still import vllm at module level (`grpo_fast.py` from `vllm.distributed.weight_transfer`, `grpo.py` via `vllm_utils`), which is not installed on Darwin. `finetune.py`, `dpo.py`, `dpo_tune_cache.py` and `reward_modeling.py` no longer import vllm on this path since [#1866](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/1866), so their scripts do not need the flag. `mason.py` prints a macOS hint but still attempts caching, so it does not protect you either way.
- The `oe-eval-internal` directory is required in the Docker image for experiments that use `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka`. If it's missing (e.g. in a fresh clone or worktree), clone it with: `git clone --depth=1 https://github.com/allenai/oe-eval-internal.git oe-eval-internal`.
- When updating PR bodies with experiment results, use the "Runs:" format (numbered list with Beaker links):
  ```
  Runs:

  1. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  2. Description: [Beaker](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)
  ```

# Naming conventions
- Models OLMo and OLMo 2 (versions <=2) use the "OLMo" capitalization style.
- Olmo 3, Olmo Hybrid, and later models use "Olmo" (standard proper noun capitalization).

Available agent types are listed in messages from the system in the conversation.

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a listing from the system with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

skill.description: The name of a skill from the available-skills list. Do not guess names.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in a message from the system. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

query.description: Query to find deferred tools. Use "select:<tool_name>" for direct selection, or keywords to search.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

script.description: Self-contained workflow script. Must begin with `export const meta = { name, description, phases }` (pure literal, no computed values) followed by the script body using agent()/parallel()/pipeline()/phase().

name.description: Name of a predefined workflow (built-in or from .claude/workflows/). Resolves to a self-contained script.

description.description: Ignored — set the workflow description in the script's `meta` block.

title.description: Ignored — set the workflow title in the script's `meta` block.

args.description: Optional input value exposed to the script as the global `args`, verbatim. Pass arrays/objects as actual JSON values, NOT as a JSON-encoded string — a stringified list breaks `args.filter`/`args.map` in the script. Use for parameterized named workflows (e.g. a research question).

scriptPath.description: Path to a workflow script file on disk. Every Workflow invocation persists its script under the session directory and returns the path in the tool result. To iterate, edit that file with Write/Edit and re-invoke Workflow with the same `scriptPath` instead of re-sending the full script. Takes precedence over `script` and `name`.

resumeFromRunId.description: Run ID of a prior Workflow invocation to resume from. The cache is positional: agent() calls replay from cache up to the first call that failed, no longer matches the earlier run (edited, added, removed or reordered) or never started in it; that call and every call after it run again, even when their own (prompt, opts) are unchanged. A call a usage limit refused, or one still running when the run stopped, usually runs again without ending reuse: finished calls after it still come from cache. Same-session only. Stop the prior run first (TaskStop) before resuming.

Writes a file to the local filesystem, overwriting if one exists.

When to use: creating a new file, or fully replacing one you've already Read. Overwriting an existing file you haven't Read will fail. For partial changes, use Edit instead.

# Reinforcement learning

For new RL, RLVR or GRPO work with supported Olmo MoE models, use
`python -m open_instruct.miles` and follow [the MILES guide](docs/miles/grpo.md),
including its launch checks and configuration conventions. Existing Core/vLLM
(`grpo.py`) and DeepSpeed/vLLM (`grpo_fast.py`) workflows remain current alternatives
for dense-model training; see [their guide](docs/algorithms/grpo.md).
Choose according to model and workload support, preserve the user's selected
workflow, and identify support gaps explicitly. MILES does not deprecate the
existing GRPO trainers.

For MILES GPU runs on `ai2/jupiter` or `ai2/saturn` (CUDA 12.8 host drivers), keep
the pinned MILES image: RunSpec defaults `launch.env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to the image's
CUDA compatibility libraries, and an explicit value wins. Revalidate CUDA
initialization and a short training run when the image or driver changes. See
[Jupiter CUDA compatibility](docs/miles/launching.md#jupiter-cuda-compatibility).

# Bash commands
- `uv run pytest`: Run the tests.
- `make style && make quality` run the linter + formatter.
- `uv run mkdocs serve`: View the documentation locally at http://127.0.0.1:8000/
- `uv run mkdocs build`: Build the documentation to the `site/` directory.



## Code Review Rules

Read and follow [CODE_REVIEW.md](CODE_REVIEW.md) when reviewing code.

# Workflow
- Begin every GitHub comment published by an agent with one plain line naming the agent (e.g. Codex, Claude Code): `Drafted by {agent name}.`, with no alert or other formatting. If a person reviewed the response before publication, use `Drafted by {agent name} and reviewed by {reviewer's name}.` instead. Only include the review attribution when that person actually reviewed the response; permission to post alone does not count as review.
- When a PR changes anything under `open_instruct/`, add a summary to `CHANGELOG.md` with a link to the PR (e.g., `- Description of change (https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/pull/123).`). This is what CI enforces; PRs touching only `scripts/`, docs, or config are exempt, though an entry is still welcome for anything user-visible.
  - The entry must contain the PR's own URL, which does not exist until the PR is opened. Add the entry, open the PR, then amend the entry with the URL and push again.
  - To skip the check deliberately, put `CHANGELOG=<reason>` in the PR body.
- Always run the linter and make sure the tests pass before finishing a task.
- Prefer running single tests, not the whole suite, when developing.
- Launch Beaker experiment and test scripts with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh [--cuda-version 12|13 [--moe]] SCRIPT` after committing all changes. CUDA 13 images are for compatible clusters such as `ai2/holmes`. MoE v2 (`OLMoDDPModel`) models, such as Olmo 3.5 Small, need `--cuda-version 13 --moe`: that image adds transformer-engine. MILES uses `--miles CONFIG` and its pinned runtime.
- For the Core/vLLM and DeepSpeed/vLLM GRPO workflows, we have three test scripts (for MILES checks, follow `docs/miles/architecture.md`):
  - `scripts/train/debug/single_gpu_on_beaker.sh`: single GPU, no tools (~8 minutes).
  - `scripts/train/debug/tools/olmo_3_parser_multigpu.sh`: multi GPU, with tools.
  - `scripts/train/debug/large_test_script.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes, no tools (~32 minutes).
- For OLMo-core SFT, we have two test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/oc_sft_multinode.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- For DPO, we have three test scripts:
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/local.sh`: local single GPU (no Beaker).
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/single_gpu.sh`: single GPU on Beaker.
  - `scripts/train/debug/dpo/multi_node.sh`: two 8x GPU nodes on Beaker.
- Launch the GPU tests with `./scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`.
- CI runs on GitHub-hosted runners without Beaker experiments or image publication. Run GPU tests manually when a change touches GPU code paths. Record `GPU_TESTS=[EXPERIMENT_ID](https://beaker.org/ex/EXPERIMENT_ID)` in the PR body for reviewers; CI does not parse or verify this line, and `GPU_TESTS=bypass` has no effect. The experiment must actually run `scripts/test/run_gpu_pytest.sh`; record training/debug smoke runs separately. Existing `open_instruct_auto*` images are no longer refreshed by CI; build from the intended revision with the launcher.
- If you are given a Beaker URL (`beaker.org` or `beaker.allen.ai`), use the Beaker CLI tool to interact with it.
- When a Beaker job stays queued or pending, run `beaker job events <job-id>` before diagnosing why — it prints the scheduler's own reason; don't infer one from cluster documentation. If that reason is the workspace slot limit, it applies to every cluster at once: wait or request fewer GPUs rather than relaunching elsewhere.
- A Beaker experiment can hold several jobs when a preempted one is retried. Read the most recently created attempt for each task and replica rank, not `jobs[0]` or one latest job for the entire experiment, or a successful retry looks like a failure and missing replicas can be overlooked.
- Mason's `--min_runtime <duration>` sets Beaker's `minRuntime` (0, or a duration with a unit of at least 5m, such as `30m`; Ai2 clusters currently allow at most 8h), and `--auto_resume` sets `autoResume`. On allocation-scheduled clusters, a job with a min runtime above 0 is allocated: it queues ahead of backfill and is protected until its min runtime ends, and shorter min runtimes schedule sooner. Its workspace needs an allocation on that cluster, or Beaker rejects it at submission. The legacy `--preemptible` switch, which cannot be combined with `--min_runtime`, maps to `minRuntime: 0` and `autoResume: true`; such unallocated jobs run only as backfill and may wait indefinitely. 74	#### 4.1.1 概念说明
75	
76	`pyproject.toml` 是现代 Python 项目的「身份证 + 装备清单」。open-instruct 在这一个文件里同时声明了：
77	
78	- 项目叫什么、支持哪个 Python 版本；
79	- 运行训练需要哪些库（torch、transformers、vllm、deepspeed、ray……）；
80	- 这些库在不同平台（Linux/macOS、x86_64/arm64）上分别怎么装；
81	- 开发工具（pytest、ruff、ty）单独归入 `dev` 组，不污染运行时；
82	- CUDA 12 与 CUDA 13 两套互斥的 GPU 栈分别归入 `cuda12` / `cuda13` 组。
83	
84	「分组」的好处：一台 CUDA 12.8 驱动的机器和一台 CUDA 13 的机器，用**同一份声明**、**不同的 `--group` 参数**就能装出各自可用的环境，且两组永远不会被同时装进一个环境（uv 的 `conflicts` 声明强制互斥）。
85	
86	#### 4.1.2 核心流程
87	
88	`uv sync` 的决策链可以概括为：
89	
90	```text
91	读取 pyproject.toml（声明）
92	    ↓
93	解析规则：
94	    - Python 版本必须满足 requires-python（==3.12.*）
95	    - 默认安装 default-groups = ["dev", "cuda12"]
96	    - cuda12 与 cuda13 互斥（conflicts）
97	    - torch/torchvision/torchaudio 的下载源按所在组切换：
98	        cuda12 组 → pytorch-cu128 索引
99	        cuda13 组 → pytorch-cu130 索引
100	    - 平台标记（marker）过滤：
101	        vllm、bitsandbytes、flash-attn 等不装到 macOS（Darwin）
102	    ↓
103	对照 uv.lock（精确版本与哈希）
104	    ↓
105	创建/更新 .venv，uv 自管 Python 3.12（python-preference = "only-managed"）
106	    ↓
107	安装 open-instruct 本身（可编辑安装）+ 所选组的全部依赖
108	```
109	
110	#### 4.1.3 源码精读
111	
112	**① Python 版本与核心依赖**
113	
114	[pyproject.toml:L1-L6](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L1-L6) 声明项目名并钉死 Python 版本为 3.12：
115	
116	```toml
117	[project]
118	name = "open-instruct"
119	dynamic = ["version"]
120	description = "Train open, instruction-following language models"
121	readme = "README.md"
122	requires-python = "==3.12.*"
123	```
124	
125	注意 `dynamic = ["version"]`：版本号不写死在文件里，而是由 git 标签动态生成（见后文 setuptools_scm）。这就是为什么 Docker 构建时要设置 `SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_OPEN_INSTRUCT` 环境变量兜底。
126	
127	[pyproject.toml:L7-L55](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L7-L55) 是运行时依赖清单，几个值得留意的条目：
128	
129	- [pyproject.toml:L32](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L32)：`"torch>=2.10.0"` —— 只写版本下限，具体装哪个 CUDA 变体由后面的 `tool.uv.sources` 决定。
130	- [pyproject.toml:L38](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L38)：`"vllm>=0.19.1; platform_system != 'Darwin'"` —— vllm 没有 macOS 版本，用平台标记排除。
131	- [pyproject.toml:L43-L45](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L43-L45)：`flash-attn`、`liger-kernel` 等同样带平台标记；`flash-attn` 在 Apple Silicon（aarch64）上也不装。
132	
133	**② 版本动态生成**
134	
135	[pyproject.toml:L57-L65](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L57-L65) 声明构建系统，并用 setuptools_scm 从 git 状态生成版本号写入 `open_instruct/_version.py`：
136	
137	```toml
138	[build-system]
139	requires = ["setuptools", "setuptools_scm>=8"]
140	build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
141	
142	[tool.setuptools_scm]
143	write_to = "open_instruct/_version.py"
144	```
145	
146	**③ CUDA 分组切换的核心：tool.uv.sources 与索引**
147	
148	这是本模块最关键的一段。[pyproject.toml:L83-L97](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L83-L97) 为 torch 三件套按「组」指定下载索引：
149	
150	```toml
151	torch = [
152	  { index = "pytorch-cu128", group = "cuda12" },
153	  { index = "pytorch-cu130", group = "cuda13" },
154	  { index = "pytorch-cu130", marker = "platform_system == 'Linux' and platform_machine == 'aarch64'" },
155	]
156	```
157	
158	读法：当解析 `cuda12` 组时，torch 一律从 `pytorch-cu128` 索引（即 CUDA 12.8 wheel）获取；解析 `cuda13` 组时改从 `pytorch-cu130` 获取。这些索引定义在 [pyproject.toml:L105-L118](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L105-L118)，都是 `explicit = true` 的专用索引（不会用于解析其他包）。[pyproject.toml:L78-L81](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L78-L81) 对 `flash-attn` 用的是另一种写法——直接按组指向不同的预编译 wheel URL。[pyproject.toml:L99-L103](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L99-L103) 则说明 vllm 的 PyPI 官方 wheel 基于 CUDA 12.8，`+cu130` 构建只发布在专用 wheel 索引上，所以只有 cuda13 组需要换源。
159	
160	**④ uv 全局行为**
161	
162	[pyproject.toml:L136-L154](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L136-L154) 定义 uv 的全局行为，四行最有信息量：
163	
164	```toml
165	[tool.uv]
166	preview = true
167	python-preference = "only-managed"   # 只用 uv 自己下载的 Python，不用系统 Python
168	default-groups = ["dev", "cuda12"]   # uv sync 默认装 dev + cuda12
169	conflicts = [
170	    [ { group = "cuda12" }, { group = "cuda13" } ],   # 两组互斥
171	]
172	```
173	
174	也就是说，在一台普通 Linux 机器上裸跑 `uv sync`，你得到的是 **dev 工具 + CUDA 12.8 训练栈**；要装 CUDA 13 栈需要显式 `uv sync --group cuda13`（此时 uv 会拒绝同时带上 cuda12）。
175	
176	**⑤ 三个依赖组的内容**
177	
178	[pyproject.toml:L156-L184](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L156-L184)：
179	
180	- `cuda12` 组（L157-L165）与 `cuda13` 组（L166-L173）：内容几乎相同（torch 三件套 + vllm + flash-attn 系列），区别只在 flash-attn-3 的 wheel 是 cu128 还是 cu130 构建。真正的版本切换靠前述 `tool.uv.sources` 完成。
181	- `dev` 组（L174-L184）：`pytest`、`ruff`、`ty`、`beaker-py`、`mkdocs-material`、`pre-commit` 等，全是开发工具，不进运行时环境也能跑训练。
182	
183	注意：transformer-engine **不在**任何依赖组里——它只存在于 `-moe` Docker 镜像变体中（见 4.3 节），本地 `uv sync` 装不到它，这是有意为之的设计。
184	
185	**⑥ requirements.txt 从哪来**
186	
187	[requirements.txt:L1-L2](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/requirements.txt#L1-L2) 的第一行就自曝了身份：
188	
189	```text

191	#    uv export --format requirements-txt --no-hashes --all-extras --group cuda12 --no-emit-project --output-file requirements.txt
192	```
193	
194	它是从 `uv.lock` 导出的 cuda12 视图，供 pip 安装路线（[installation.md:L6-L16](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/docs/get_started/installation.md#L6-L16)）使用。pre-commit 里还有个钩子保证 `uv.lock` 变化时它会被重新导出（见 4.4.3）。**不要手改这个文件。**

238	**练习 1**：为什么 torch 只写 `>=2.10.0`，而不直接在依赖里写死 CUDA 版本？
239	**答案**：因为同一个 torch 版本号对应多个按 CUDA 分别编译的 wheel。CUDA 变体的选择放在 [tool.uv.sources](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L83-L97) 里按依赖组切换：cuda12 组走 `pytorch-cu128` 索引，cuda13 组走 `pytorch-cu130` 索引。版本约束管「哪个版本」，source 管「哪个构建」。

241	**练习 2**：裸跑 `uv sync`（不带任何参数）会安装哪些组？

247	### 4.2 Dockerfile 构建入口
248	
249	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
250	
251	训练大模型通常不在笔记本上跑，而是提交到 GPU 集群（open-instruct 默认对接 Allen AI 的 Beaker）。集群环境不可控，所以要把「操作系统 + CUDA 工具链 + Python 依赖 + 仓库代码」整体打包成 Docker 镜像。open-instruct 的 `Dockerfile` 有三个鲜明特点：
252	
253	1. **一个文件支持两代 CUDA × 两个变体**：用多阶段构建 + 构建参数，`--build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12|13` 选 CUDA 代际，`--build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT=""|"-moe"` 选是否叠加 transformer-engine（仅 CUDA 13 有 `-moe` 变体），组合出 cuda12 / cuda13 / cuda13-moe 三种镜像。
254	2. **镜像内用 uv 装依赖**：镜像里不手写 pip 命令，而是复用 4.1 节的同一套 `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock`，做到「本地环境和镜像环境来自同一份声明」。
255	3. **变体差异收拢在一个 `if` 里**：MoE 专用组件全部集中在一条带条件守卫的 `RUN` 指令中，默认镜像执行到它时是空操作（详见 4.3 节）。
256	
257	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
258	
259	镜像构建流程：
260	
261	```text
262	docker build --build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12|13 --build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT=""|"-moe" .
263	    ↓
264	选择基础镜像：
265	    cuda12     → nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu22.04
266	    cuda13     → nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu22.04
267	    cuda13-moe → nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04
268	    ↓
269	apt 安装基础工具（git/make/curl/nginx 等）
270	    ↓
271	安装 DOCA OFED 用户态驱动、Google Cloud CLI、Beaker CLI
272	    ↓
273	拷入 uv 可执行文件（官方镜像 ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv）
274	    ↓
275	uv run --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION}
276	    → 按 uv.lock 精确安装依赖 + 下载 nltk 数据
277	    ↓
278	【仅 -moe 变体】安装 transformer-engine、替换 cuBLAS、符号自检（见 4.3 节）
279	    ↓
280	COPY 仓库代码（configs/scripts/mason.py/open_instruct/oe-eval-internal）
281	    ↓
282	设置 PATH 指向 /stage/.venv/bin，容器内命令直接可用
283	```
284	
285	#### 4.2.3 源码精读
286	
287	**① 三个基础阶段与变体选择**
288	
289	[Dockerfile:L1-L12](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L1-L12)：
290	
291	```dockerfile
292	ARG CUDA_VERSION=12
293	# "" or "-moe" (CUDA 13 only): the -moe image adds transformer-engine for MoE v2 models; see below.
294	ARG IMAGE_VARIANT=""
295	FROM nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda12
296	FROM nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13
297	FROM nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13-moe
298	# torch is built with CUDA 13.0; without this DeepSpeed refuses to JIT-build its ops (CPU Adam) against 13.3.
299	ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1
300	FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}
301	
302	ARG CUDA_VERSION
303	ARG IMAGE_VARIANT
304	```
305	
306	要点逐条拆解：
307	
308	- 前两个 `ARG` 是全局默认值：CUDA 代际默认 12，变体默认空串。`IMAGE_VARIANT` 只接受 `""` 或 `"-moe"`，且注释写明 **-moe 仅限 CUDA 13**。
309	- 三个 `FROM ... AS` 各定义一个基础阶段，第四个 `FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}` 用字符串拼接选择从哪个阶段继续——`12`+`""` 得 cuda12 镜像，`13`+`""` 得 cuda13 镜像，`13`+`"-moe"` 得 cuda13-moe 镜像。这是 Docker 的「条件基础镜像」惯用法。
310	- `ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 位于 `FROM ... AS cuda13-moe` 之后、最终 `FROM` 之前，属于 **cuda13-moe 阶段内部**的指令——只有以它为基座的 `-moe` 镜像才继承这个变量，默认镜像完全不受影响（动机见 4.3 节）。
311	- 最终阶段里重新 `ARG CUDA_VERSION` / `ARG IMAGE_VARIANT`：Docker 的 ARG 在进入新阶段后失效，重新声明才能在后续指令（L85 的 `--group cuda${CUDA_VERSION}`、L98 的 if 守卫）里继续使用。
312	
313	默认值是 12，AI2 的 Jupiter/Saturn 集群（CUDA 12.8 宿主驱动）就用默认；Holmes 等 CUDA 13 集群用 `--build-arg CUDA_VERSION=13`；MoE v2 模型再叠加 `--build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT="-moe"`。
314	
315	**② 基础工具与集群设施**
316	
317	[Dockerfile:L18-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L18-L28) 安装 build-essential、git、make、nginx 等基础工具；[Dockerfile:L59-L70](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L59-L70) 安装固定版本（v1.5.235）的 Beaker CLI，供集群上提交任务使用。这些与 Python 无关，却是集群可运行性的保障。
318	
319	**③ 拷入 uv 并装配依赖**
320	
321	[Dockerfile:L72](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L72) 从官方镜像拷入 uv 0.8.6（CI 的 [tests.yml:L24-L27](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.github/workflows/tests.yml#L24-L27) 也用同一版本，保持一致）。随后是整个镜像最核心的一步：
322	
323	[Dockerfile:L82-L86](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L82-L86)：
324	
325	```dockerfile
326	RUN --mount=type=cache,target=${UV_CACHE_DIR} \
327	    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
328	    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \
329	    uv run --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION} \
330	        python -m nltk.downloader punkt punkt_tab words
331	```
332	
333	这段做了三件事：
334	
335	- 用 `--frozen` 严格按 `uv.lock` 安装（代码改动不会引起依赖漂移）；
336	- 用 `--no-default-groups` **关掉**默认组，再显式指定 `--group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION}`——因为默认组固定是 cuda12，而镜像需要按构建参数在 cuda12/cuda13 之间切换；
337	- 顺手下载 nltk 的分词数据（`punkt punkt_tab words`），数学判分等模块要用。
338	
339	注意这里只 bind-mount 了 `uv.lock` 和 `pyproject.toml`，**还没拷贝任何源码**——依赖层和代码层分离，代码改动时依赖层缓存依然有效，这是镜像构建加速的关键技巧。
340

384	### 4.3 CUDA 13 MoE 镜像变体：transformer-engine、DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK 与 cuBLAS 手术
385	
386	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
387	
388	先补几个初学者可能陌生的名词：
389	
390	- **MoE（Mixture of Experts，混合专家）**：一种模型结构。每层有一个路由器（router），把每个 token 分发给少数几个「专家」前馈网络计算，而不是让所有 token 过同一个巨大的 FFN。**MoE v2** 指 OLMo-core 的第二代 MoE 实现，载体是 `OLMoDDPModel`（走 OLMo-core 的 DDP 训练模块而不是 FSDP），代表模型是 **Olmo 3.5 Small（A4B）**。
391	- **token permutation（token 重排）**：MoE 高效批处理的关键操作——把路由到同一专家的 token 在内存里排到一起，算完再排回去。OLMo-core 的 MoE v2 把这个重排算子委托给 transformer-engine。
392	- **transformer-engine（TE）**：NVIDIA 的高性能算子库。open-instruct 的默认镜像**不装**它；只有 `-moe` 变体镜像装（版本 2.16.1）。
393	- **cuBLAS / cuBLASLt**：NVIDIA 的矩阵乘法运行库。torch 的 wheel 自带一份（venv 里的 `nvidia/cu13/lib` 下，随 `nvidia-cublas` pip 包分发），CUDA 基础镜像的工具链目录（`/usr/local/cuda/lib64`）里也有系统副本。两份版本不同，**导出的符号（可调用函数名）集合可能不同**。
394	- **DeepSpeed 的 CUDA 版本检查**：DeepSpeed JIT 编译自家算子（如 CPU Adam）时会校验「本机 CUDA 工具链版本」与「torch 编译时用的 CUDA 版本」是否一致，不一致就直接拒绝构建。`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 让它跳过这道校验。
395	
396	这个模块解决的问题是：**MoE v2 模型需要 TE，但把 TE 装进镜像会连带引出一串 CUDA 库兼容性手术，影响面大到不能动默认镜像**。于是一条独立的 `-moe` 变体诞生了。整个来龙去脉写在 Dockerfile 的注释块里（[Dockerfile:L88-L95](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L88-L95)），按因果链捋一遍：
397	
398	1. MoE v2（`OLMoDDPModel`）的 token permutation 依赖 TE 的算子（OLMo-core 的 `olmo_core/nn/moe/utils.py`），默认镜像没有 TE → 需要一个装了 TE 的镜像。
399	2. TE 2.16.1 的预编译 cu13 库会调用 `cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal` 这个符号，而 torch 自带的 cuBLAS（nvidia-cublas 13.1.0.3）**不导出**它 → 直接装 TE，一运行就找不到符号。
400	3. 解法：把 venv 里 torch 自带的 `libcublas` / `libcublasLt` **替换成（符号链接到）基础镜像里更新的系统副本**（CUDA 13.3 工具链的 `/usr/local/cuda/lib64`）。
401	4. 为什么不用 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 指过去？因为 torch 是**按 venv 内的绝对路径**加载自带库的，动态链接器的搜索路径对它无效——只能替换文件本身。
402	5. 为什么不直接改默认 cuda13 镜像？因为这一替换**改变了镜像里所有程序用的 cuBLAS**，影响面太大，所以隔离成独立变体，两个默认镜像保持原样。
403	6. `-moe` 的基座是 CUDA **13.3.1**（比默认 cuda13 的 13.0.3 新），正是为了拿到带那个符号的系统 cuBLAS；但 torch 是按 CUDA 13.0 编译的，于是有了 `DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1`（让 DeepSpeed 仍然用 13.3 工具链 JIT 构建算子）。
404	7. 最后加一道**构建期自检**：用 `nm` 列出替换后 `libcublasLt` 导出的符号、用 `grep` 确认目标符号在——缺了就让整个构建失败，把问题从「运行时神秘崩溃」提前到「构建时大声报错」。
405

410	```text

412	    ├─ 否（默认 cuda12/cuda13）→ 整个 RUN 块为空操作，什么都不装、什么都不改

566	### 4.4 Makefile 质量工具链
567	
568	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
569	
570	研究代码库最怕「每个人一套风格」。open-instruct 用一个 28 行的 Makefile 把格式化、静态检查、测试统一成两条命令：
571	
572	- `make style`：**格式化**（自动改写你的代码排版）；
573	- `make quality`：**质量检查**（lint 自动修复 + 语法编译检查 + 类型检查）。
574	
575	配套还有 `-check` 变体（`style-check` / `quality-check`）：不改文件、只报告问题并以非零退出码失败，供 CI 使用。此外仓库用 pre-commit 把同样的检查挂到 `git commit` 上，用根目录 `conftest.py` 让 pytest 在缺少 vllm/GPU 的机器上自动跳过相关测试。
576	
577	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
578	
579	```text
580	开发者改完代码
581	    ↓
582	make style            → ruff format 改写排版（可能修改文件）
583	make quality          → ① check-keywords：确认没有违禁关键字 nonlocal
584	                        ② ruff check --fix：lint 并自动修复
585	                        ③ python -m compileall：语法编译检查
586	                        ④ ty check：类型检查
587	    ↓
588	uv run pytest         → conftest.py 先探测 vllm / CUDA 可用性
589	                        → 不可用的测试文件加入 collect_ignore，自动跳过
590	    ↓
591	git commit            → pre-commit 钩子再跑一遍 ruff + 关键字检查
592	                        + uv.lock 变化时重新导出 requirements.txt
593	    ↓
594	CI（.github/workflows）→ uv sync --frozen 装环境 → uv run --frozen pytest
595	```
596	
597	#### 4.4.3 源码精读
598	
599	**① Makefile 的目标定义**
600	
601	[Makefile:L1-L9](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Makefile#L1-L9)：
602	
603	```makefile
604	.PHONY: style quality check-keywords
605	
606	# make sure to test the local checkout in scripts and not the pre-installed one (don't use quotes!)
607	export PYTHONPATH = open_instruct
608	
609	check_dirs := open_instruct *mason.py
610	
611	style:
612		uv run ruff format $(check_dirs)
613	```
614	
615	- `check_dirs` 限定检查范围：`open_instruct/` 目录和根目录的 `mason.py`（`*mason.py` 同样匹配 `test_mason.py`）。
616	- `export PYTHONPATH = open_instruct` 确保测试跑的是本地检出代码而非 pip 装的旧版。
617	
618	[Makefile:L11-L14](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Makefile#L11-L14) 定义 quality 门禁：
619	
620	```makefile
621	quality: check-keywords
622		uv run ruff check -q --fix $(check_dirs)
623		uv run python -m compileall -qq $(check_dirs)
624		uv run ty check
625	```
626	
627	注意 `quality` 依赖 `check-keywords`，会先跑它。[Makefile:L24-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Makefile#L24-L28) 是这个特殊检查：
628	
629	```makefile
630	# TYPE_CHECKING is allowed so optional dependencies stay out of runtime imports.
631	# Share the remaining keyword policy between pre-commit and CI.
632	check-keywords:
633		@test -d open_instruct/
634		@grep -rn --include='*.py' -E 'nonlocal[[:space:]]' open_instruct/; test $$? -eq 1
635	```
636	
637	逻辑是：grep 查找 `nonlocal ` 关键字，要求其退出码为 1（即「什么都没找到」）——找到了反而算失败。`nonlocal` 在多进程/分布式训练代码里是雷区，所以干脆全面禁用。
638	
639	**② 提交前钩子与 CI 保持同一套规则**
640	
641	[.pre-commit-config.yaml:L20-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L20-L28) 挂载 ruff 与 ruff-format 钩子（作用域同样是 `open_instruct/` 和 `*mason.py`）；[.pre-commit-config.yaml:L30-L37](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L30-L37) 的 `ban-keywords` 钩子直接复用 `make check-keywords`；[.pre-commit-config.yaml:L38-L43](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L38-L43) 的 `export-requirements` 钩子在 `uv.lock` 变化时自动重新导出 `requirements.txt`——这就是 4.1.3 里「该文件是自动生成的」的机制保障。

643	CI 侧，[.github/workflows/tests.yml:L28-L35](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.github/workflows/tests.yml#L28-L35) 展示了官方装配顺序：`uv sync --frozen` → 下载 nltk `punkt_tab` → `uv run --frozen pytest`。你在本地照着做，就能最大程度复现 CI 行为。

727	## 6. 本讲小结
728	
729	- open-instruct 用 **uv + `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock`** 管理依赖：Python 钉死 3.12，默认装 `dev + cuda12` 两组，`cuda12`/`cuda13` 通过 `conflicts` 互斥、通过 `tool.uv.sources` 切换 torch/vllm 的 wheel 索引。
730	- **平台差异用 marker 声明**：vllm、bitsandbytes、flash-attn 等不进 macOS 环境，一份声明适配多平台。
731	- **`requirements.txt` 是 `uv.lock` 的自动导出物**（pip 路线用），由 pre-commit 钩子保持同步，不要手改。
732	- **Dockerfile 一个文件出三种镜像**：`ARG CUDA_VERSION`（12/13）选 CUDA 代际与依赖组，`ARG IMAGE_VARIANT`（空/`-moe`）叠加 MoE 变体；依赖层与代码层分离以利用缓存；镜像内同样用 uv + `--frozen`，与本地同源。
733	- **`-moe` 变体专供 MoE v2（`OLMoDDPModel`，如 Olmo 3.5 Small）**：13.3.1-cudnn 基座 + transformer-engine 2.16.1（绑定 venv 的 torch 编译）+ `DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` + cuBLAS 指向系统副本 + `nm` 构建期符号自检；全部收在一条 `if` 守卫的 RUN 里，`ENV` 也只属于 cuda13-moe 阶段，**两个默认镜像完全不受影响**；运行期另有 `require_transformer_engine` 启动检查兜底。
734	- **质量工具链三条命令**：`uv run pytest`（conftest 自动跳过缺 vllm/GPU 的用例）、`make style`（ruff format 改写排版）、`make quality`（关键字检查 + ruff lint + compileall + ty）。
735	- **文档可能滞后**（Python 3.10 vs 3.12、不存在的 `Dockerfile.uv`），冲突时以 `pyproject.toml`、`uv.lock`、`Dockerfile` 为准。

# 环境搭建：uv、Docker 与开发工具链

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 用 `uv sync` 在本地装好 open-instruct 的完整开发环境，并说清楚它到底装了什么、为什么这么装。
2. 读懂 `pyproject.toml` 中的依赖分组（`dev` / `cuda12` / `cuda13`）与 `tool.uv.sources` 的 CUDA 版本切换机制，理解同一份依赖声明如何支撑不同 GPU 平台。
3. 读懂 `Dockerfile` 的三个基础阶段（`cuda12` / `cuda13` / `cuda13-moe`）与 `IMAGE_VARIANT` 构建参数，理解训练镜像为什么长这样。
4. 说清楚 `-moe` 变体额外引入了什么（transformer-engine 2.16.1、`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1`、cuBLAS 指向系统副本与构建期符号检查）、它专供哪些模型（MoE v2，即 `OLMoDDPModel`，如 Olmo 3.5 Small），以及两个默认镜像为什么完全不受影响。
5. 掌握日常开发三板斧：`uv run pytest` 跑测试、`make style` 格式化、`make quality` 过质量门禁，并知道它们背后分别是 ruff、ty、compileall 等哪些工具。

本讲不涉及任何模型训练，只解决一件事：**把环境搭对，把工具链用起来**。这是后面所有讲义的前置条件。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 依赖管理器：从 pip 到 uv

- **pip**：Python 最经典的包管理器，按 `requirements.txt` 逐个安装，但不负责「锁版本」和「建虚拟环境」。
- **虚拟环境（venv）**：一个隔离的 Python 解释器 + 依赖目录，避免不同项目之间依赖互相污染。传统流程是 `python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate`。
- **uv**：Astral 公司用 Rust 写的下一代 Python 包管理器，一条 `uv sync` 命令可以同时完成「下载指定版本的 Python 解释器 + 创建 `.venv` + 按 lock 文件精确安装所有依赖」，速度比 pip 快一个数量级。open-instruct 已经把 uv 作为主力安装方式（安装文档中标注为 preview），Docker 镜像里也用它装依赖。
- **lock 文件（`uv.lock`）**：把「我想要 torch>=2.10」这种模糊声明解析成「装 torch 2.10.x 的某个具体 wheel 及其哈希」的精确快照。CI 和 Docker 构建都用 `--frozen` 模式，即「只按 lock 装，不许重新解析」，保证所有人环境一致。

### 2.2 Python、PyTorch 与 CUDA 的三角关系

深度学习环境最常见的坑：PyTorch 的 wheel（预编译包）是**按 CUDA 版本分别编译**的。同样是 `torch==2.10.0`，CUDA 12.8 的 Linux 版和 CUDA 13.0 的 Linux 版是两个不同的文件，来自不同的下载索引。所以「装哪个 torch」取决于「你的机器驱动支持哪代 CUDA」。open-instruct 用 uv 的**依赖分组（dependency groups）**把这两套 wheel 隔开，这是本讲的重点之一。

同一份 torch wheel 里还会**自带**一批 NVIDIA 运行库（cuBLAS、cuDNN 等，以 `nvidia-*` pip 包的形式躺在 venv 里），torch 是按 venv 内的绝对路径加载它们的——这个细节是理解本讲 4.3 节 MoE 镜像变体的关键。

### 2.3 工具链里的每个工具是干什么的

| 工具 | 角色 | 一句话说明 |
|---|---|---|
| ruff | 格式化 + Lint | 用 Rust 写的超快工具，`ruff format` 管代码排版，`ruff check` 找坏味道（未用 import、可疑写法等） |
| ty | 类型检查 | Astral 的 Python 类型检查器，静态发现类型错误 |
| compileall | 语法检查 | 把所有 `.py` 编译成字节码，能抓到语法错误 |
| pytest | 测试框架 | 自动发现并运行 `test_*.py` 里的用例 |
| pre-commit | Git 钩子管理 | 在 `git commit` 前自动跑格式化和检查 |
| mkdocs | 文档站 | 把 `docs/` 渲染成可搜索的文档网站 |
| Docker / Beaker | 容器 / AI2 集群 | 把环境打包成镜像，在 GPU 集群上复现 |

### 2.4 一条重要提醒：文档会滞后，源码是真相

安装文档 `docs/get_started/installation.md` 开头写的是「Dockerfile 使用 Python 3.10」，还提到了一个 `Dockerfile.uv` 文件。但你核对当前仓库会发现：`pyproject.toml` 钉死的是 **Python 3.12**，仓库里也**只有 `Dockerfile` 一个 Dockerfile**（它本身就内置了 uv）。这是研究代码库的常态——文档更新赶不上代码。本讲会同时告诉你「文档怎么说」和「源码实际是什么」，并教你在两者冲突时以 `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock` + `Dockerfile` 为准。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| [pyproject.toml](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml) | 项目元数据、依赖声明、uv 分组与索引、ruff/ty/pytest 配置，**本讲最核心的文件** |

| [open_instruct/test_math_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/test_math_utils.py) | 本讲实践用的最小测试文件 |
| [scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh) | AI2 内部用户「构建镜像 + 提交 Beaker」的一键脚本，含 `--cuda-version` 与 `--moe` 参数 |
| [open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/open_instruct/olmo_core_utils.py) | `require_transformer_engine`：MoE v2 训练启动期的 transformer-engine 检查与报错指引 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

本讲拆成四个最小模块：

1. **依赖声明与 uv 分组**（`pyproject.toml` 为主）
2. **Dockerfile 构建入口**（镜像里如何复用同一套依赖声明、如何选择 CUDA 阶段与变体）
3. **CUDA 13 MoE 镜像变体**（`cuda13-moe`：transformer-engine、`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK` 与 cuBLAS 手术）
4. **Makefile 质量工具链**（ruff / ty / pytest / pre-commit 如何串成门禁）

### 4.1 依赖声明与 uv 分组

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`pyproject.toml` 是现代 Python 项目的「身份证 + 装备清单」。open-instruct 在这一个文件里同时声明了：

- 项目叫什么、支持哪个 Python 版本；
- 运行训练需要哪些库（torch、transformers、vllm、deepspeed、ray……）；
- 这些库在不同平台（Linux/macOS、x86_64/arm64）上分别怎么装；
- 开发工具（pytest、ruff、ty）单独归入 `dev` 组，不污染运行时；
- CUDA 12 与 CUDA 13 两套互斥的 GPU 栈分别归入 `cuda12` / `cuda13` 组。

「分组」的好处：一台 CUDA 12.8 驱动的机器和一台 CUDA 13 的机器，用**同一份声明**、**不同的 `--group` 参数**就能装出各自可用的环境，且两组永远不会被同时装进一个环境（uv 的 `conflicts` 声明强制互斥）。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`uv sync` 的决策链可以概括为：

```text
读取 pyproject.toml（声明）
    ↓
解析规则：
    - Python 版本必须满足 requires-python（==3.12.*）
    - 默认安装 default-groups = ["dev", "cuda12"]
    - cuda12 与 cuda13 互斥（conflicts）
    - torch/torchvision/torchaudio 的下载源按所在组切换：
        cuda12 组 → pytorch-cu128 索引
        cuda13 组 → pytorch-cu130 索引
    - 平台标记（marker）过滤：
        vllm、bitsandbytes、flash-attn 等不装到 macOS（Darwin）
    ↓
对照 uv.lock（精确版本与哈希）
    ↓
创建/更新 .venv，uv 自管 Python 3.12（python-preference = "only-managed"）
    ↓
安装 open-instruct 本身（可编辑安装）+ 所选组的全部依赖
```

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**① Python 版本与核心依赖**

[pyproject.toml:L1-L6](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L1-L6) 声明项目名并钉死 Python 版本为 3.12：

```toml
[project]
name = "open-instruct"
dynamic = ["version"]
description = "Train open, instruction-following language models"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = "==3.12.*"
```

注意 `dynamic = ["version"]`：版本号不写死在文件里，而是由 git 标签动态生成（见后文 setuptools_scm）。这就是为什么 Docker 构建时要设置 `SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION_FOR_OPEN_INSTRUCT` 环境变量兜底。

[pyproject.toml:L7-L55](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L7-L55) 是运行时依赖清单，几个值得留意的条目：

- [pyproject.toml:L32](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L32)：`"torch>=2.10.0"` —— 只写版本下限，具体装哪个 CUDA 变体由后面的 `tool.uv.sources` 决定。
- [pyproject.toml:L38](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L38)：`"vllm>=0.19.1; platform_system != 'Darwin'"` —— vllm 没有 macOS 版本，用平台标记排除。
- [pyproject.toml:L43-L45](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L43-L45)：`flash-attn`、`liger-kernel` 等同样带平台标记；`flash-attn` 在 Apple Silicon（aarch64）上也不装。

**② 版本动态生成**

[pyproject.toml:L57-L65](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L57-L65) 声明构建系统，并用 setuptools_scm 从 git 状态生成版本号写入 `open_instruct/_version.py`：

```toml
[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools", "setuptools_scm>=8"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools_scm]
write_to = "open_instruct/_version.py"
```

**③ CUDA 分组切换的核心：tool.uv.sources 与索引**

这是本模块最关键的一段。[pyproject.toml:L83-L97](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L83-L97) 为 torch 三件套按「组」指定下载索引：

```toml
torch = [
  { index = "pytorch-cu128", group = "cuda12" },
  { index = "pytorch-cu130", group = "cuda13" },
  { index = "pytorch-cu130", marker = "platform_system == 'Linux' and platform_machine == 'aarch64'" },
]
```

读法：当解析 `cuda12` 组时，torch 一律从 `pytorch-cu128` 索引（即 CUDA 12.8 wheel）获取；解析 `cuda13` 组时改从 `pytorch-cu130` 获取。这些索引定义在 [pyproject.toml:L105-L118](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L105-L118)，都是 `explicit = true` 的专用索引（不会用于解析其他包）。[pyproject.toml:L78-L81](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L78-L81) 对 `flash-attn` 用的是另一种写法——直接按组指向不同的预编译 wheel URL。[pyproject.toml:L99-L103](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L99-L103) 则说明 vllm 的 PyPI 官方 wheel 基于 CUDA 12.8，`+cu130` 构建只发布在专用 wheel 索引上，所以只有 cuda13 组需要换源。

**④ uv 全局行为**

[pyproject.toml:L136-L154](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L136-L154) 定义 uv 的全局行为，四行最有信息量：

```toml
[tool.uv]
preview = true
python-preference = "only-managed"   # 只用 uv 自己下载的 Python，不用系统 Python
default-groups = ["dev", "cuda12"]   # uv sync 默认装 dev + cuda12
conflicts = [
    [ { group = "cuda12" }, { group = "cuda13" } ],   # 两组互斥
]
```

也就是说，在一台普通 Linux 机器上裸跑 `uv sync`，你得到的是 **dev 工具 + CUDA 12.8 训练栈**；要装 CUDA 13 栈需要显式 `uv sync --group cuda13`（此时 uv 会拒绝同时带上 cuda12）。

**⑤ 三个依赖组的内容**

[pyproject.toml:L156-L184](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/pyproject.toml#L156-L184)：

- `cuda12` 组（L157-L165）与 `cuda13` 组（L166-L173）：内容几乎相同（torch 三件套 + vllm + flash-attn 系列），区别只在 flash-attn-3 的 wheel 是 cu128 还是 cu130 构建。真正的版本切换靠前述 `tool.uv.sources` 完成。
- `dev` 组（L174-L184）：`pytest`、`ruff`、`ty`、`beaker-py`、`mkdocs-material`、`pre-commit` 等，全是开发工具，不进运行时环境也能跑训练。

注意：transformer-engine **不在**任何依赖组里——它只存在于 `-moe` Docker 镜像变体中（见 4.3 节），本地 `uv sync` 装不到它，这是有意为之的设计。

**⑥ requirements.txt 从哪来**

[requirements.txt:L1-L2](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/requirements.txt#L1-L2) 的第一行就自曝了身份：

```text
# This file was autogenerated by uv via the following command:
#    uv export --format requirements-txt --no-hashes --all-extras --group cuda12 --no-emit-project --output-file requirements.txt
```

它是从 `uv.lock` 导出的 cuda12 视图，供 pip 安装路线（[installation.md:L6-L16](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/docs/get_started/installation.md#L6-L16)）使用。pre-commit 里还有个钩子保证 `uv.lock` 变化时它会被重新导出（见 4.4.3）。**不要手改这个文件。**

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：用 `uv sync` 装好环境，并验证你装到的正是声明所描述的那套依赖。

**操作步骤**：

1. 确认已安装 uv（未安装可 `curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh`，这也是 [build_image_and_launch.sh:L114-L118](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/scripts/train/build_image_and_launch.sh#L114-L118) 使用的安装方式）。
2. 在仓库根目录执行：

   ```bash
   uv sync
   ```

3. 验证解释器与关键库版本：

   ```bash
   uv run python -c "import sys; print(sys.version)"
   uv run python -c "import torch; print(torch.__version__)"
   ```

4. 验证平台差异（在 Linux 上执行应成功；在 macOS 上执行应报 `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'vllm'`，因为 L38 的标记把它排除了）：

   ```bash
   uv run python -c "import vllm; print(vllm.__version__)"
   ```

5. 验证 transformer-engine 确实不在本地环境（应报 `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'transformer_engine'`）：

   ```bash
   uv run python -c "import transformer_engine; print(transformer_engine.__version__)"
   ```

**需要观察的现象**：

- `uv sync` 首次运行会下载一个 uv 托管的 Python 3.12 并创建 `.venv/` 目录；
- `sys.version` 输出 3.12.x；
- `torch.__version__` 在 cuda12 默认组下应带 `cu128` 字样（具体小版本以 lock 为准，待本地验证）。

**预期结果**：所有命令退出码为 0（macOS 上第 4 步、所有平台上第 5 步的报错本身也是「符合预期」的结果，说明平台标记与「TE 只随镜像分发」的设计生效）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

### 4.2 Dockerfile 构建入口

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

训练大模型通常不在笔记本上跑，而是提交到 GPU 集群（open-instruct 默认对接 Allen AI 的 Beaker）。集群环境不可控，所以要把「操作系统 + CUDA 工具链 + Python 依赖 + 仓库代码」整体打包成 Docker 镜像。open-instruct 的 `Dockerfile` 有三个鲜明特点：

1. **一个文件支持两代 CUDA × 两个变体**：用多阶段构建 + 构建参数，`--build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12|13` 选 CUDA 代际，`--build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT=""|"-moe"` 选是否叠加 transformer-engine（仅 CUDA 13 有 `-moe` 变体），组合出 cuda12 / cuda13 / cuda13-moe 三种镜像。
2. **镜像内用 uv 装依赖**：镜像里不手写 pip 命令，而是复用 4.1 节的同一套 `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock`，做到「本地环境和镜像环境来自同一份声明」。
3. **变体差异收拢在一个 `if` 里**：MoE 专用组件全部集中在一条带条件守卫的 `RUN` 指令中，默认镜像执行到它时是空操作（详见 4.3 节）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

镜像构建流程：

```text
docker build --build-arg CUDA_VERSION=12|13 --build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT=""|"-moe" .
    ↓
选择基础镜像：
    cuda12     → nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu22.04
    cuda13     → nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu22.04
    cuda13-moe → nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04
    ↓
apt 安装基础工具（git/make/curl/nginx 等）
    ↓
安装 DOCA OFED 用户态驱动、Google Cloud CLI、Beaker CLI
    ↓
拷入 uv 可执行文件（官方镜像 ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv）
    ↓
uv run --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION}
    → 按 uv.lock 精确安装依赖 + 下载 nltk 数据
    ↓
【仅 -moe 变体】安装 transformer-engine、替换 cuBLAS、符号自检（见 4.3 节）
    ↓
COPY 仓库代码（configs/scripts/mason.py/open_instruct/oe-eval-internal）
    ↓
设置 PATH 指向 /stage/.venv/bin，容器内命令直接可用
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**① 三个基础阶段与变体选择**

[Dockerfile:L1-L12](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L1-L12)：

```dockerfile
ARG CUDA_VERSION=12
# "" or "-moe" (CUDA 13 only): the -moe image adds transformer-engine for MoE v2 models; see below.
ARG IMAGE_VARIANT=""
FROM nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda12
FROM nvidia/cuda:13.0.3-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13
FROM nvidia/cuda:13.3.1-cudnn-devel-ubuntu22.04 AS cuda13-moe
# torch is built with CUDA 13.0; without this DeepSpeed refuses to JIT-build its ops (CPU Adam) against 13.3.
ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1
FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}

ARG CUDA_VERSION
ARG IMAGE_VARIANT
```

要点逐条拆解：

- 前两个 `ARG` 是全局默认值：CUDA 代际默认 12，变体默认空串。`IMAGE_VARIANT` 只接受 `""` 或 `"-moe"`，且注释写明 **-moe 仅限 CUDA 13**。
- 三个 `FROM ... AS` 各定义一个基础阶段，第四个 `FROM cuda${CUDA_VERSION}${IMAGE_VARIANT}` 用字符串拼接选择从哪个阶段继续——`12`+`""` 得 cuda12 镜像，`13`+`""` 得 cuda13 镜像，`13`+`"-moe"` 得 cuda13-moe 镜像。这是 Docker 的「条件基础镜像」惯用法。
- `ENV DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 位于 `FROM ... AS cuda13-moe` 之后、最终 `FROM` 之前，属于 **cuda13-moe 阶段内部**的指令——只有以它为基座的 `-moe` 镜像才继承这个变量，默认镜像完全不受影响（动机见 4.3 节）。
- 最终阶段里重新 `ARG CUDA_VERSION` / `ARG IMAGE_VARIANT`：Docker 的 ARG 在进入新阶段后失效，重新声明才能在后续指令（L85 的 `--group cuda${CUDA_VERSION}`、L98 的 if 守卫）里继续使用。

默认值是 12，AI2 的 Jupiter/Saturn 集群（CUDA 12.8 宿主驱动）就用默认；Holmes 等 CUDA 13 集群用 `--build-arg CUDA_VERSION=13`；MoE v2 模型再叠加 `--build-arg IMAGE_VARIANT="-moe"`。

**② 基础工具与集群设施**

[Dockerfile:L18-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L18-L28) 安装 build-essential、git、make、nginx 等基础工具；[Dockerfile:L59-L70](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L59-L70) 安装固定版本（v1.5.235）的 Beaker CLI，供集群上提交任务使用。这些与 Python 无关，却是集群可运行性的保障。

**③ 拷入 uv 并装配依赖**

[Dockerfile:L72](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L72) 从官方镜像拷入 uv 0.8.6（CI 的 [tests.yml:L24-L27](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.github/workflows/tests.yml#L24-L27) 也用同一版本，保持一致）。随后是整个镜像最核心的一步：

[Dockerfile:L82-L86](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L82-L86)：

```dockerfile
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=${UV_CACHE_DIR} \
    --mount=type=bind,source=uv.lock,target=uv.lock \
    --mount=type=bind,source=pyproject.toml,target=pyproject.toml \
    uv run --frozen --no-default-groups --group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION} \
        python -m nltk.downloader punkt punkt_tab words
```

这段做了三件事：

- 用 `--frozen` 严格按 `uv.lock` 安装（代码改动不会引起依赖漂移）；
- 用 `--no-default-groups` **关掉**默认组，再显式指定 `--group dev --group cuda${CUDA_VERSION}`——因为默认组固定是 cuda12，而镜像需要按构建参数在 cuda12/cuda13 之间切换；
- 顺手下载 nltk 的分词数据（`punkt punkt_tab words`），数学判分等模块要用。

注意这里只 bind-mount 了 `uv.lock` 和 `pyproject.toml`，**还没拷贝任何源码**——依赖层和代码层分离，代码改动时依赖层缓存依然有效，这是镜像构建加速的关键技巧。

**④ 代码层与环境变量**

[Dockerfile:L115-L119](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L115-L119) 拷贝仓库代码。其中 `COPY oe-eval-interna[l] oe-eval-internal/` 的方括号是 Docker 的 glob 技巧：目录存在时正常拷贝，不存在时也不让构建失败（CLAUDE.md 说明该目录是 `--try_launch_beaker_eval_jobs_on_weka` 实验所必需，缺失时需自行 clone）。[Dockerfile:L121-L126](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L121-L126) 把 git 提交号写进环境变量，并把 `/stage/.venv/bin` 放进 PATH——容器里直接敲 `python` 就是刚装好的环境。

**⑤ 文档中已失效的引用**

[installation.md:L41-L49](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/docs/get_started/installation.md#L41-L49) 提到「用 `Dockerfile.uv` 构建带 uv 的镜像」，但当前仓库已经没有这个文件——因为主 `Dockerfile` 本身就内置了 uv（见上文 L72、L82-L86）。同样，[installation.md:L4](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/docs/get_started/installation.md#L4) 说「使用 Python 3.10」，而 `pyproject.toml` 已钉到 3.12。读文档时请以源码为准，这是研究仓库的生存技能。

### 4.3 CUDA 13 MoE 镜像变体：transformer-engine、DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK 与 cuBLAS 手术

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

先补几个初学者可能陌生的名词：

- **MoE（Mixture of Experts，混合专家）**：一种模型结构。每层有一个路由器（router），把每个 token 分发给少数几个「专家」前馈网络计算，而不是让所有 token 过同一个巨大的 FFN。**MoE v2** 指 OLMo-core 的第二代 MoE 实现，载体是 `OLMoDDPModel`（走 OLMo-core 的 DDP 训练模块而不是 FSDP），代表模型是 **Olmo 3.5 Small（A4B）**。
- **token permutation（token 重排）**：MoE 高效批处理的关键操作——把路由到同一专家的 token 在内存里排到一起，算完再排回去。OLMo-core 的 MoE v2 把这个重排算子委托给 transformer-engine。
- **transformer-engine（TE）**：NVIDIA 的高性能算子库。open-instruct 的默认镜像**不装**它；只有 `-moe` 变体镜像装（版本 2.16.1）。
- **cuBLAS / cuBLASLt**：NVIDIA 的矩阵乘法运行库。torch 的 wheel 自带一份（venv 里的 `nvidia/cu13/lib` 下，随 `nvidia-cublas` pip 包分发），CUDA 基础镜像的工具链目录（`/usr/local/cuda/lib64`）里也有系统副本。两份版本不同，**导出的符号（可调用函数名）集合可能不同**。
- **DeepSpeed 的 CUDA 版本检查**：DeepSpeed JIT 编译自家算子（如 CPU Adam）时会校验「本机 CUDA 工具链版本」与「torch 编译时用的 CUDA 版本」是否一致，不一致就直接拒绝构建。`DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` 让它跳过这道校验。

这个模块解决的问题是：**MoE v2 模型需要 TE，但把 TE 装进镜像会连带引出一串 CUDA 库兼容性手术，影响面大到不能动默认镜像**。于是一条独立的 `-moe` 变体诞生了。整个来龙去脉写在 Dockerfile 的注释块里（[Dockerfile:L88-L95](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L88-L95)），按因果链捋一遍：

1. MoE v2（`OLMoDDPModel`）的 token permutation 依赖 TE 的算子（OLMo-core 的 `olmo_core/nn/moe/utils.py`），默认镜像没有 TE → 需要一个装了 TE 的镜像。
2. TE 2.16.1 的预编译 cu13 库会调用 `cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal` 这个符号，而 torch 自带的 cuBLAS（nvidia-cublas 13.1.0.3）**不导出**它 → 直接装 TE，一运行就找不到符号。
3. 解法：把 venv 里 torch 自带的 `libcublas` / `libcublasLt` **替换成（符号链接到）基础镜像里更新的系统副本**（CUDA 13.3 工具链的 `/usr/local/cuda/lib64`）。
4. 为什么不用 `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` 指过去？因为 torch 是**按 venv 内的绝对路径**加载自带库的，动态链接器的搜索路径对它无效——只能替换文件本身。
5. 为什么不直接改默认 cuda13 镜像？因为这一替换**改变了镜像里所有程序用的 cuBLAS**，影响面太大，所以隔离成独立变体，两个默认镜像保持原样。
6. `-moe` 的基座是 CUDA **13.3.1**（比默认 cuda13 的 13.0.3 新），正是为了拿到带那个符号的系统 cuBLAS；但 torch 是按 CUDA 13.0 编译的，于是有了 `DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1`（让 DeepSpeed 仍然用 13.3 工具链 JIT 构建算子）。
7. 最后加一道**构建期自检**：用 `nm` 列出替换后 `libcublasLt` 导出的符号、用 `grep` 确认目标符号在——缺了就让整个构建失败，把问题从「运行时神秘崩溃」提前到「构建时大声报错」。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`-moe` 变体的装配流程（发生在依赖安装之后、代码 COPY 之前）：

```text
IMAGE_VARIANT == "-moe" ？
    ├─ 否（默认 cuda12/cuda13）→ 整个 RUN 块为空操作，什么都不装、什么都不改
    └─ 是 →
        ① uv pip install cmake ninja pybind11 setuptools wheel   （TE 源码编译需要的构建工具）
        ② 从 venv 的 nvidia.cudnn 包定位 cuDNN 目录，
           设 CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH / C_INCLUDE_PATH / LIBRARY_PATH （让 TE 构建找得到 cuDNN 头文件与库）
        ③ MAX_JOBS=$TE_MAX_JOBS uv pip install --no-build-isolation
           "transformer-engine[pytorch]==2.16.1"                  （绑定本 venv 的 torch 编译 Python 绑定）
        ④ 对 libcublasLt、libcublas：
           把 venv 的 nvidia/cu13/lib/*.so.13 符号链接到
           /usr/local/cuda/lib64 下更新的系统副本                （补齐 TE 需要的符号）
        ⑤ nm -D 列出 libcublasLt 导出符号
           | grep cublasLtGroupedMatrixLayoutInit_internal        （构建期符号自检，缺了即失败）
```

配套的运行期防线：训练脚本启动时若发现模型是 `OLMoDDPModel`，会调用 `require_transformer_engine()` 检查 TE 算子可用，不可用立即报错并给出正确启动命令——镜像里没 TE 时不会等到第一次 forward 才崩。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**① 为什么需要独立变体：注释块与并行度参数**

[Dockerfile:L88-L96](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Dockerfile#L88-L96) 是整个变体的「设计文档」，说明了上面 4.3.1 的完整因果链（TE 的 cu13 库需要 torch 自带 cuBLAS 没有的符号、替换会波及全镜像所以独立成变体、TE 的 Python 绑定按 venv 的 torch 与 cuDNN 头编译）。末尾一行构建参数：

```dockerfile
ARG TE_MAX_JOBS=2
```

`TE_MAX_JOBS` 控制 TE 源码编译的并行任务数；默认 2 是为了塞进 Docker Desktop 8 GiB 内存的虚拟机，在内存充裕的 Linux 构建机上可以调大加速编译。

**② 条件装配的 RUN 块**


### 4.4 Makefile 质量工具链

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

研究代码库最怕「每个人一套风格」。open-instruct 用一个 28 行的 Makefile 把格式化、静态检查、测试统一成两条命令：

- `make style`：**格式化**（自动改写你的代码排版）；
- `make quality`：**质量检查**（lint 自动修复 + 语法编译检查 + 类型检查）。

配套还有 `-check` 变体（`style-check` / `quality-check`）：不改文件、只报告问题并以非零退出码失败，供 CI 使用。此外仓库用 pre-commit 把同样的检查挂到 `git commit` 上，用根目录 `conftest.py` 让 pytest 在缺少 vllm/GPU 的机器上自动跳过相关测试。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
开发者改完代码
    ↓
make style            → ruff format 改写排版（可能修改文件）
make quality          → ① check-keywords：确认没有违禁关键字 nonlocal
                        ② ruff check --fix：lint 并自动修复
                        ③ python -m compileall：语法编译检查
                        ④ ty check：类型检查
    ↓
uv run pytest         → conftest.py 先探测 vllm / CUDA 可用性
                        → 不可用的测试文件加入 collect_ignore，自动跳过
    ↓
git commit            → pre-commit 钩子再跑一遍 ruff + 关键字检查
                        + uv.lock 变化时重新导出 requirements.txt
    ↓
CI（.github/workflows）→ uv sync --frozen 装环境 → uv run --frozen pytest
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**① Makefile 的目标定义**

[Makefile:L1-L9](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Makefile#L1-L9)：

```makefile
.PHONY: style quality check-keywords

# make sure to test the local checkout in scripts and not the pre-installed one (don't use quotes!)
export PYTHONPATH = open_instruct

check_dirs := open_instruct *mason.py

style:
	uv run ruff format $(check_dirs)
```

- `check_dirs` 限定检查范围：`open_instruct/` 目录和根目录的 `mason.py`（`*mason.py` 同样匹配 `test_mason.py`）。
- `export PYTHONPATH = open_instruct` 确保测试跑的是本地检出代码而非 pip 装的旧版。

[Makefile:L11-L14](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Makefile#L11-L14) 定义 quality 门禁：

```makefile
quality: check-keywords
	uv run ruff check -q --fix $(check_dirs)
	uv run python -m compileall -qq $(check_dirs)
	uv run ty check
```

注意 `quality` 依赖 `check-keywords`，会先跑它。[Makefile:L24-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/Makefile#L24-L28) 是这个特殊检查：

```makefile
# TYPE_CHECKING is allowed so optional dependencies stay out of runtime imports.
# Share the remaining keyword policy between pre-commit and CI.
check-keywords:
	@test -d open_instruct/
	@grep -rn --include='*.py' -E 'nonlocal[[:space:]]' open_instruct/; test $$? -eq 1
```

逻辑是：grep 查找 `nonlocal ` 关键字，要求其退出码为 1（即「什么都没找到」）——找到了反而算失败。`nonlocal` 在多进程/分布式训练代码里是雷区，所以干脆全面禁用。

**② 提交前钩子与 CI 保持同一套规则**

[.pre-commit-config.yaml:L20-L28](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L20-L28) 挂载 ruff 与 ruff-format 钩子（作用域同样是 `open_instruct/` 和 `*mason.py`）；[.pre-commit-config.yaml:L30-L37](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L30-L37) 的 `ban-keywords` 钩子直接复用 `make check-keywords`；[.pre-commit-config.yaml:L38-L43](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.pre-commit-config.yaml#L38-L43) 的 `export-requirements` 钩子在 `uv.lock` 变化时自动重新导出 `requirements.txt`——这就是 4.1.3 里「该文件是自动生成的」的机制保障。

CI 侧，[.github/workflows/tests.yml:L28-L35](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/.github/workflows/tests.yml#L28-L35) 展示了官方装配顺序：`uv sync --frozen` → 下载 nltk `punkt_tab` → `uv run --frozen pytest`。你在本地照着做，就能最大程度复现 CI 行为。

**③ pytest 的环境自适应**

[conftest.py:L5-L20](https://github.com/allenai/open-instruct/blob/a4cd966a9e202843baba653115045e6fd6f473db/conftest.py#L5-L20)：根目录的 conftest 先试探 vllm 是否可导入、CUDA 是否可用，然后把依赖它们的测试文件追加进 `collect_ignore`。效果是：在没有 GPU 的笔记本上 `uv run pytest` 也不会因 vllm/GPU 用例报错，它们被静默跳过。

- open-instruct 用 **uv + `pyproject.toml` + `uv.lock`** 管理依赖：Python 钉死 3.12，默认装 `dev + cuda12` 两组，`cuda12`/`cuda13` 通过 `conflicts` 互斥、通过 `tool.uv.sources` 切换 torch/vllm 的 wheel 索引。
- **平台差异用 marker 声明**：vllm、bitsandbytes、flash-attn 等不进 macOS 环境，一份声明适配多平台。
- **`requirements.txt` 是 `uv.lock` 的自动导出物**（pip 路线用），由 pre-commit 钩子保持同步，不要手改。
- **Dockerfile 一个文件出三种镜像**：`ARG CUDA_VERSION`（12/13）选 CUDA 代际与依赖组，`ARG IMAGE_VARIANT`（空/`-moe`）叠加 MoE 变体；依赖层与代码层分离以利用缓存；镜像内同样用 uv + `--frozen`，与本地同源。
- **`-moe` 变体专供 MoE v2（`OLMoDDPModel`，如 Olmo 3.5 Small）**：13.3.1-cudnn 基座 + transformer-engine 2.16.1（绑定 venv 的 torch 编译）+ `DS_SKIP_CUDA_CHECK=1` + cuBLAS 指向系统副本 + `nm` 构建期符号自检；全部收在一条 `if` 守卫的 RUN 里，`ENV` 也只属于 cuda13-moe 阶段，**两个默认镜像完全不受影响**；运行期另有 `require_transformer_engine` 启动检查兜底。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a message from the system confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a message from the system confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.
